catalog.title: Scribble Picture 6
catalog.process_notes:
Walk around take pictures of NYC. Bring the RAW image into Adobe lightroom and push it around. Settled on a bleached out color spectrum. Pop the image into Adobe Fresco.

First layer is drawing body parts in black ink. The same pen is used to graffiti text in the image. Body parts are filled. Opacity of layers are adjusted. Add another layer of color stuff for fun.

described.alt_text: A photograph of the Empire State Building with a crane, where clouds, water towers, billboards and a kiosk have been outlined and filled with flat cartoon colour, above a plaza of yellow umbrellas, signed 2023.
described.description: A portrait format digital piece on a photograph, signed 2023 at lower right. The Empire State Building rises at centre with a yellow outlined construction crane drawn on its lower floors, against a sky with rainbow streaks. A large white cloud is outlined in black like a cartoon. Beige and brick buildings on the left carry outlined grey water towers and small drawn panels; a tall pale blue block drawn in outline stands at right beside a cartoon tower. A lamp post at centre right carries an outlined banner with a drawing of the Flatiron Building and a pink splat. Below, a brown kiosk with a scribbled sign, yellow umbrellas, trees drawn as green outlines and a few faceless figures fill a plaza, with a white outlined box at lower centre.
described.impression: The city starting to turn into a drawing: the clouds, the water towers and a whole building at right have gone cartoon while the Empire State stays photographic. The hand drawn crane on the landmark is a cheeky touch, as if the picture were repairing it. The most colourful of the first batch and a step toward the later, more drawn Scribble pictures.
described.format_notes: Digital drawing over a Fujifilm X-H2 photograph. Print available.
